units.source_text: “我不知道那封信已经被人看过了，所以还是一副无所谓的神气。

en.t: “I did not know that letter had already been read by someone, so I still wore an unconcerned expression.

units.source_text: 至今还不晓得信已经被人发现，反而倒好。”

en.t: Even now, not knowing that the letter had already been discovered was actually for the best.”
